text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today was the Derby for the next 
generation down. The heavy favorite, Air 
Shakur, missed out on the crown by a mere 
7 centimeters...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she wasn't particularly 
downhearted. Apparently, this outcome was 
well within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The future—converges according to the 
numerical values. If that holds true, 
Meisho Doto's future should also stay 
within its calculated upper limit, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, since Meisho Doto is inherently 
unpredictable, they hold out hope that she 
might just upset all calculations.
